Do not hoard everything you find in the Zone. As a rule, items found in the Zone - such as artifacts, weapons, and food - can be contaminated with radiation. 
 
To check if an item is contaminated, highlight it with your cursor. Messer's Geiger counter will start ticking if the item is radioactive.
 
Keep in mind that contaminated items will continue to emit radiation even when stored in your backpack, slowly irradiating you over time.
To crouch, press ($$ACTION_crouch$$). To crouch even lower, press ($$ACTION_crouch$$) + ($$ACTION_accel$$)
Some stalkers will refuse to talk to you if you stick your weapon in their face. To hide your weapon, pull out a bolt. ($$ACTION_wpn_6$$).
Jumping will help you climb onto, or over objects. To jump, press ($$ACTION_jump$$)

You're not a mule, so there's a limit to how much you can carry. When the weight of your gear exceeds your carrying capacity, you will start losing energy very quickly. \n \nYou can monitor the current weight of your equipment and your maximum carrying capacity in the inventory screen.

When Messer wears a radioactive artifact on his belt or enters an area with high background radiation, he will begin losing health and show signs of radiation poisoning. \n \nThe effects of radiation poisoning can be countered by using anti-radiation drugs or vodka.

By helping other characters, you improve their attitude toward you and raise your overall reputation. 
 
A better reputation and positive relationships make interactions easier. People who like you will offer better prices when trading and may share useful information. 
 
However, if you attack someone, their attitude toward you will instantly turn hostile, as will that of their friends, and they will likely attack you on sight.

This is a good place to hit the sack. Here you can get a good night's sleep, wait out the night, or simply kill some time. \n \nTo go to sleep, open your Inventory, set the amount of time you want to rest, and press the Rest button. Messer will wake up at the designated time. Sometimes, he will even have dreams.

Sometimes you will need to sprint for one reason or another. To do this, press ($$ACTION_sprint_toggle$$) while running. Sprinting will cause Messer to run faster and jump farther, but he will tire more quickly and will be unable to shoot his gun.

If Messer does not eat for a while, he becomes hungry. If he doesn't find something to eat, he will start losing health. \n \nTo prevent this, Messer must eat regularly. A loaf of bread, tinned food, or a piece of sausage will satisfy his hunger, at least for a while.

Running for a prolonged period of time causes fatigue. When Messer becomes exhausted, he will no longer be able to run and will move at walking pace. \n \nThe more weight Messer carries in his inventory, the faster his stamina drains. Standing still for a moment is usually enough to recover your stamina.

All weapons have a durability parameter. The lower a weapon's durability, the more often it will jam. \n \nTo unjam a weapon, reload it by pressing $$ACTION_wpn_reload$$. Weapon durability decreases with use. If a weapon is hit by gunfire, it will likely be rendered inoperable.

When Messer is hit, he may start to bleed. This will cause him to constantly lose health. The more serious the bleeding, the faster he loses health. \n \nA green icon indicates minor bleeding, while a red icon means a serious hemorrhage. Bleeding will eventually stop on its own, but you can stop even serious bleeding immediately by using bandages.

Exoskeletons rely on a specialized battery pack to function at full capacity. When the battery is depleted, movement speed is significantly reduced. A charged exoskeleton also allows you to sprint while holding a Gauss Rifle. 
 
The exoskeleton or its battery can be recharged at the scientists' base. 
 
To insert the battery pack, drag it onto the exoskeleton icon or right-click the battery. To remove it, right-click the exoskeleton.
Anomaly detectors worn on the belt slowly drain the device's battery. To replace the detector's battery, drag a fresh battery onto its icon.
